# skasim gallery

> A gallery of end-to-end radio-interferometric simulations of the Square Kilometre Array (SKA) and its precursors, made with skasim by the CSIC4SKA project at the Instituto de Astrofísica de Andalucía (IAA-CSIC). Each case runs a sky model through visibility simulation and imaging, and reports the resulting images, beams and noise levels.

skasim is a researcher-oriented simulation package for the SKA Observatory (SKAO) telescopes and other radio interferometers, such as MeerKAT, the VLA and ALMA. It is built on the Karabo pipeline, uses OSKAR and WSClean, and takes a user-supplied sky model to visibilities, dirty and CLEANed images, uv coverage and a weblog per run.

## Science cases

- [Case 1 — MIGHTEE deep field](https://espsrc.github.io/skasim-gallery/case1-mightee/): the MIGHTEE DR1 COSMOS field at L-band observed with MeerKAT, SKA1-MID (AA*) and the VLA in B and D configurations, in four matched runs over a 0.2° field, comparing sensitivity, angular resolution and uv coverage.
- [Case 2 — Circular polarization in the confusion limit](https://espsrc.github.io/skasim-gallery/case2-polarization/): a 2 h SKA-LOW-AAstar observation at 175 MHz of a 1° field with 60 462 T-RECS sources; two faint, 80% circularly polarized sources are recovered blindly in Stokes V at +8.1σ and −6.3σ, with no false positives.
- [Case 3 — SKAO staged delivery](https://espsrc.github.io/skasim-gallery/case3-staged-delivery/): a 0.6° portion of the SKA Data Challenge 1 catalogue observed in SKA-MID Band 2 (950–1670 MHz) by each array assembly, from AA0.5 to the AA4 design baseline.
- [Case 4 — Redshifted radio galaxies](https://espsrc.github.io/skasim-gallery/case4-redshift-galaxies/): Arp 220 and Arp 299 placed at z = 0.15–2.0 and observed with SKA-MID-AA* at 1.35, 6.5 and 11.9 GHz, with cosmological dimming, angular-size scaling and star-formation-rate evolution applied.
- [Case 5 — HI gas kinematics in spiral galaxies](https://espsrc.github.io/skasim-gallery/case5-hi-kinematics/): a pyHIARD spiral galaxy observed in the HI 21-cm line with SKA-MID-AA* for 20 min at inclinations of 10°, 45° and 80°, with moment maps and position–velocity diagrams.
